# LLM & Foundation Model Resources

Telecom- and wireless-specific datasets, evaluation benchmarks, and suites for large language models and foundation models.

Cross-cutting AI resources are grouped here without treating LLMs or foundation models as wireless research tasks.

**Core task-mapped datasets in this collection:** 2  
**Supporting resources in this collection:** 8

| Dataset | Wireless tasks |

| [TeleLogs](../datasets/telelogs.md) | [Network Fault Diagnosis](../tasks/network-fault-diagnosis.md) |
